text: Transportation Services recommends that the portions of Varna Drive and Cather Crescent and all of Trafford Lane be permanently closed for incorporation into the Lawrence Heights Revitalization Project - Northeast District. A new public road network will be constructed to replace the above-noted closed public highways as part of the revitalization project.

City Council on July 16, 17 and 18, 2019 adopted the following: 1. City Council authorize the phased permanent closure of portions of the public highways named Varna Drive and Cather Crescent, shown as Parts 1 and 2 respectively on Sketch PS-2019-050 (the "Stage 3 Highways"); portions of Varna Drive and Cather Crescent, shown as Parts 1 and 2 respectively on Sketch PS-2019-051 (the "Stage 4 Highways") and the portion of Cather Crescent and Trafford Lane, shown as Parts 1 and 2 respectively on Sketch PS-2019-049 (the "Stage 5 Highways"), attached to the report (June 6, 2019) from the Director, Transportation Planning and Capital Program, Transportation Services. 2. City Council enact the by-laws substantially in the form of the draft By-laws attached as Appendices A and B to the report (June 6, 2019) from the Director, Transportation Planning and Capital Program, Transportation Services.
